CVE-2026-103995.description: Response body and chunk parsing would handle non-hex or negative integers incorrectly which could result in misinterpreting HTTP response contents.

CVE-2026-114583.title: tarfile.tar_filter could be bypassed using crafted link entries,  ...
CVE-2026-114583.description:
tarfile.tar_filter could be bypassed using crafted link entries, including symlinks with empty or directory-like names, to redirect later archive members outside the intended extraction directory. This allowed a malicious tar archive to cause tarfile.extractall() with filter="tar" to write files outside the destination directory, subject to the permissions of the extracting process.

This is the tarfile.tar_filter counterpart of CVE-2026-7774, which covered tarfile.data_filter.

CVE-2026-115557.title: Python has added a denylist for known compromised certificates to ...
CVE-2026-115557.description: Python has added a denylist for known compromised certificates to the "ssl" module to ensure user safety even without certificate revocation configured. Known compromised certificates will automatically be rejected regardless of the SSLContext policy configuration.

CVE-2026-116566.title: socket.getaddrinfo() previously accepted null bytes within *host* ...
CVE-2026-116566.description: socket.getaddrinfo() previously accepted null bytes within *host* and *port* parameters which can cause the values to be silently truncated.

CVE-2026-12345.title: The cleanup of tempfile.TemporaryDirectory is vulnerable to a rac ...
CVE-2026-12345.description: The cleanup of tempfile.TemporaryDirectory is vulnerable to a race condition. An attacker who can modify the tree during cleanup can replace a directory with a symbolic link, causing files outside of the temporary directory to be deleted or have their permissions and file flags reset, with the privileges of the process performing the cleanup. Note that platforms where shutil.rmtree.avoids_symlink_attacks is false, remain affected, and file flags may still be reset outside of the tree on all platforms.

CVE-2024-3220.title: There is a defect in the CPython standard library module “mimetyp ...
CVE-2024-3220.description:
There is a defect in the CPython standard library module “mimetypes” where on Windows the default list of known file locations are writable meaning other users can create invalid files to cause MemoryError to be raised on Python runtime startup or have file extensions be interpreted as the incorrect file type.

This defect is caused by the default locations of Linux and macOS platforms (such as “/etc/mime.types”) also being used on Windows, where they are user-writable locations (“C:\etc\mime.types”).

To work-around this issue a user can call mimetypes.init() with an empty list (“[]”) on Windows platforms to avoid using the default list of known file locations.

CVE-2026-124249.title: http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response  ...
CVE-2026-124249.description:
http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.

CVE-2026-19552.title: When ca_certs parameter was supplied to ssl.get_server_certificat ...
CVE-2026-19552.description: When ca_certs parameter was supplied to ssl.get_server_certificate() function, the identity of the certificate is not checked.

CVE-2026-87910.title: When tarfile extracts a link on a system that doesn't support lin ...
CVE-2026-87910.description: When tarfile extracts a link on a system that doesn't support links, it falls back to extracting a member from the archive. In this case, the filter function is run twice: once for the extracted member, and once with name set to the location of the link. For one of the calls, the return value was ignored. Instead, the member should be skipped if either call returns None.
